summary: Diff adds an `isPublished` flag per memory with a toggle endpoint, plus a frontend share-mode (`?share=true`) that shows a public gallery of all published memories via `listPublishedMemories()`/`getPublishedMemory()`. However, the BuildRequest’s core requirement of a per-owner publish state and a generated/regenerated share identifier/token (used to fetch only that owner’s published memories) is not implemented, and the public APIs shown are not token-scoped. Access-control guarantees around unauthenticated callers and existing endpoints cannot be fully verified from the truncated backend diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend stores a per-owner publish state that can be enabled/disabled; backend generates (and can regenerate) a share identifier/token for the owner that is used in the public link; backend provides query methods to fetch the published memories by share identifier/token; invalid/disabled share should return empty/clear error without exposing private memories.
missing_requirements.reason: Implementation uses a per-memory `isPublished` flag and a global share mode (`?share=true`) with public queries `listPublishedMemories()`/`getPublishedMemory(id)` that are not scoped by an owner-specific share identifier/token. No evidence of per-owner publish state or token generation/regeneration or token-based public query methods.
evidence: backend/main.mo (adds Memory.isPublished and togglePublishMemory; shows MemoryPublic but no token/share-id fields in snippet)
frontend/src/hooks/useSharedMemories.ts (calls actor.listPublishedMemories() and actor.getPublishedMemory(id) with no token parameter)
frontend/src/App.tsx (detects share mode via `share=true` query param)

missing_requirements.requirement: Unauthenticated callers cannot access private memories via existing endpoints; published memories are accessible only through new public-share query APIs and only with a valid share identifier/token; existing authenticated endpoints keep enforcing owner-only access.
missing_requirements.reason: Diff shows new publishing toggle and new public listing/get hooks, but provides no evidence of token-gated public access or of hardened access control changes on existing endpoints. Backend snippet is truncated at `getMemory`, so owner-only enforcement and unauthenticated behavior cannot be confirmed.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; shows togglePublishMemory authorization, but existing read/list endpoints and new public endpoints are not shown/verified)
frontend/src/hooks/useSharedMemories.ts (public fetching uses listPublishedMemories without token gating)

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend UI provides controls to enable publishing, disable publishing, and copy the current share link; indicates current publishing status; if not authenticated, controls hidden or access-required message shown.
missing_requirements.reason: UI added appears to toggle publish state per memory (not per owner), and the share link is a static `?share=true` rather than an owner’s share identifier/token. Also no evidence in the added PublishShareCard snippet that controls are hidden/blocked when unauthenticated (it relies on listMemories error handling returning empty).
evidence: frontend/src/features/memories/PublishShareCard.tsx (uses per-memory toggle; shareUrl is `?share=true`; no auth-gating shown in snippet)
frontend/src/hooks/useSharePublishing.ts (listMemories returns [] on Unauthorized, rather than showing explicit access-required UI)

missing_requirements.requirement: Public shared-memories mode detects a share identifier/token in URL and uses backend public-share query API to fetch only that owner’s published memories; invalid/unpublished shows clear empty/error state.
missing_requirements.reason: Share mode detection is `share=true` rather than a share identifier/token, and fetching uses `listPublishedMemories()` with no token. This does not meet the requirement of not allowing public browsing without a share identifier/token.
evidence: frontend/src/features/memories/SharedMemoriesPage.tsx (empty state exists, but no token-based lookup)

hallucinated_features.description: Public share mode that exposes published memories via a global `?share=true` URL parameter rather than an owner-specific share identifier/token.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly requires a share identifier/token and forbids allowing the public link to browse/discover all users’ memories without a share identifier/token. The diff implements share mode without any token and queries published memories globally.

hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest asks for per-owner publish state and token generation/regeneration; diff implements publishing as a flag on each memory and a toggle endpoint.
